test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Diesel) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The camshaft is driven by the crankshaft through which of the following types of power transmission techniques?
solution:
The correct answer is __Timing gear drive__.

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Timing gear drive__ is used to transmit motion from the crankshaft to the camshaft.
 
• It ensures proper synchronization of the engine’s valve timing.
 
• Timing gear drive is precise and reliable for maintaining the correct timing.
 
• It is commonly used in internal combustion engines.
 
• This mechanism ensures smooth operation and reduces the chances of errors in valve timing.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Flat Belt Transmission Drive:**

 
 
• Flat belt drives are used to transmit power between two parallel shafts using a belt.
 
• They are not suitable for camshaft and crankshaft connections.
 
 
 
• **Epicyclic Gear Train Drive:**
 
 
• Epicyclic gear trains are used in planetary gear systems for torque transmission.
 
• They are not typically used for camshaft drives.
 
 
 
• **Chain Drive:**
 
 
• Chain drives use a chain and sprockets to transmit motion.
 
• Though used in some engines, they are less precise compared to timing gear drives.
